shortlist.label: Plasmablastic lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: CD138-positive, CD56-positive, EBV-positive, and gains of fluorescence signal at multiple loci

shortlist.label: Extramedullary plasmacytoma
shortlist.why_kept: CD138-positive and soft tissue polypoid density on Computed Tomographic Imaging

shortlist.label: Nasal natural killer/T-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Unilateral nasal congestion and obstruction with a polypoid mass in the nasal cavity

shortlist.label: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: CD20-negative and PAX5-negative, but gains of fluorescence signal at multiple loci

shortlist.label: Lymphomatoid granulomatosis
shortlist.why_kept: EBV-positive and gains of fluorescence signal at multiple loci, although less likely

raw.rationale: The presence of CD138-positive and CD56-positive staining, along with EBV-positive status and gains of fluorescence signal at multiple loci, is consistent with plasmablastic lymphoma, a type of non-Hodgkin lymphoma that often presents with extranodal involvement and has a high proliferation rate.

rejected.label: Extramedullary plasmacytoma
rejected.why: While CD138-positive, the presence of EBV and CD56 positivity is not typical for extramedullary plasmacytoma

rejected.label: Nasal natural killer/T-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: The immunophenotype described does not match typical nasal NK/T-cell lymphoma, which is usually CD56-positive but also often expresses T-cell or NK-cell markers

rejected.label: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: The lack of CD20 and PAX5 expression makes diffuse large B-cell lymphoma less likely

rejected.label: Lymphomatoid granulomatosis
rejected.why: The clinical presentation and immunophenotypic profile do not align with lymphomatoid granulomatosis, which is often associated with angiocentric and angiodestructive lesions
